title: Credit card
summary: Recreate a bank card: exact card proportions, layered glows, a gold chip, spaced numbers and a blended logo.
brief: The card is 340px wide with the real card proportion (aspect-ratio 1.586), 24px padding included in that size, 16px corners and white text. Its chip, number and footer are spread from top to bottom.

Background, top layer first: a white glow (25%) in the top right corner fading out by 40%, a pink glow (rgb(236 72 153 / 0.5)) in the bottom left fading out by 50%, over a 135deg gradient from #1e1b4b to #4338ca. Shadow: 0 16px 32px rgb(67 56 202 / 0.35).
The chip is a 44 × 32px gold gradient (#fde68a to #d97706, 135deg) with 6px corners and a 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2) border. The number is monospace, 20px, letter-spacing 0.12em, word-spacing 0.4em.

Footer: holder and expiry (label over value, 2px apart; labels uppercase, 0.1em spacing, 70% opacity; values 14px semibold) aligned to the bottom, 24px apart, and the logo pushed to the far right: two 32px circles overlapping by 12px, the second blended with screen so only the overlap mixes.
hints: width: 340px with aspect-ratio: 1.586 sets the height. box-sizing: border-box keeps the padding inside that size. Make the card a grid with align-content: space-between to spread its three children vertically.

Layer the glows: radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25), transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 0 100%, rgb(236 72 153 / 0.5), transparent 50%), linear-gradient(135deg, #1e1b4b, #4338ca).

The footer is flex with align-items: flex-end; margin-left: auto on .brand pushes it right. The second circle gets margin-left: -12px and mix-blend-mode: screen; isolation: isolate on .brand stops it blending with the card behind.
solutionNotes: aspect-ratio gives the card its real proportions from a width alone, and box-sizing: border-box keeps the padding inside it. A grid with align-content: space-between spreads three rows to the top, middle and bottom without measuring anything. In the footer, margin-left: auto on the logo eats all the free space and pushes it to the far edge. The blend is the subtle part: mix-blend-mode mixes with everything painted behind, including the card gradient, so the whole second circle would change colour; isolation: isolate on .brand gives the logo its own group, so the circle only blends where it overlaps the first one.
